meta: What is an AI agent and what should you give it: the common mistake is giving it the wrong task. An agent is AI that does several steps for you.

muc.title: Handing over the wrong task
muc.text: The common mistake with AI agents is handing over the wrong task. An agent, AI that does several steps for you, is good at clear tasks that are easy to check.

muc.title: Tasks to hand over
muc.text: Hand over tasks where mistakes can be fixed, like gathering information, comparing prices or drafting.

muc.title: Tasks not to hand over yet
muc.text: Don't hand over tasks that are hard to undo, like paying, emailing clients, deleting files or deciding for you.

muc.title: The three-part test
muc.text: The test has three parts: you can describe the result, you can check it in minutes, and a mistake won't cost much.

muc.title: Score your five tasks
muc.text: List five tasks from this week and ask a chatbot to score each one on the three tests above.
